title: A scale-free density bound for Gaussian maxima
summary: We derive a scale-free bound on the density of the maximum of a centered Gaussian vector. The basic bound is non-uniform, depends logarithmically on the dimension, and allows any covariance matrix. When the largest marginal variance is separated from zero, it implies that the density of the maximum is uniformly controlled at all quantiles above ${2}/{3}$, which is sufficient for many hypothesis testing applications; it yields validity of Gaussian and bootstrap approximations for maxima of high-dimensional sums at test levels $α< {1}/{3}$ without further restricting the covariance.
